script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: career transition

Begin screenplay.

Title:
RENEWED PASSIONS

INT. KITCHEN - DAY

FELIX, a talented but disenchanted graphic designer, slices a tomato in half for a salad, lost in thought. SARA, a passionate and ambitious photographer, enters from the living room, setting down her camera.

SARA: (smiling) Hey, I saw that look on your face. What's got you all lost in thought?

FELIX: (sighs) Another mundane design project. I'm just not feeling it anymore, Sara.

SARA: (gently) You know, I've seen so many people like you, talented and passionate, get stuck in the same rut. It's time for a change.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Felix and Sara sit on the couch, brainstorming ideas for Felix's career transition.

FELIX: I've always loved to paint, but I don't know if I can make a living from it.

SARA: Have you considered taking classes or workshops? Maybe even selling your artwork online?

FELIX: I suppose I could try.

SARA: (encouragingly) And if it doesn't work out? You'll still have your design job to fall back on.

INT. ART GALLERY - DAY

Felix stands in front of a painting, taking in the colors and textures. SARA enters, snapping photos.

SARA: (excitedly) Look at this one! I think it has real potential.

FELIX: (smiling) I'm glad you like it. I've never been this excited about a project before.

INT. STUDIO APARTMENT - NIGHT

Felix works late into the night on a new painting. Sara enters, bringing him a cup of coffee.

SARA: (softly) You're really good at this, Felix. Keep going.

FELIX: (smiling) Thanks, Sara. I couldn't do it without your encouragement.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Felix and Sara sit at a table, discussing the logistics of selling Felix's artwork online.

FELIX: I still have a lot to learn about marketing and selling art online.

SARA: That's why we'll take classes together. We can learn and grow as a team.

FELIX: (smiling) I like the sound of that.

INT. APARTMENT BUILDING LOBBY - NIGHT

Felix and Sara walk to their apartment, hand in hand.

FELIX: I never thought I could be this happy, Sara. You've really changed my perspective on life.

SARA: (smiling) I'm just here to support you, Felix. And who knows? Maybe I'll start selling my own photography one day.

FELIX: (laughs) I'll be your biggest fan.

INT. ART STUDIO - DAY

Felix works on a new painting, surrounded by his growing collection of art. Sara enters, snapping photos.

SARA: (proudly) This is amazing, Felix. I can't wait to see where this new path takes you.

FELIX: (smiling) And I can't wait to take it with you by my side.

FADE OUT.
